description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Prepare an invoice to one of the creator's clients as a Draft, paid in full or split. client.email is where the link goes: without it (and send_by email or both) the tool answers needs_client_email. send_by self emails nothing. Nothing is sent and no number is used: a Draft goes to the client only through send_draft, after the creator has seen it and said yes. The invoice number is given only when it is sent.

brief.description: Notes for the creator's own record

client.description: Who the quote or invoice is for

email.description: Where the link goes (needed unless send_by is sms)

phone_country.description: Two-letter country of the phone, like GH

deposit.description: A custom deposit then the rest: a whole percent 1 to 99, or an amount

amount.description: In major units, as a string, like "241.62"

lines.description: The priced parts. The total is always their sum.

from.description: A base price that may rise; changes no maths

unit_price.description: In major units, as a string, like "241.62"

send_by.description: How the client gets it once sent. Default email. self: nothing goes to the client; the creator downloads the PDF from Piku and sends it themselves, so no email is needed.

split.description: How a one-off invoice is paid. Default in_full. For a deposit of your own, use deposit instead.

name: create_invoice
title: Draft an invoice
